{{Quote|General Grievous has been spotted on a number of occasions traveling to planet Nelvaan deep in the Outer Rim Territories. I'm told he's there right now.|Palpatine to Anakin Skywalker and Obi-Wan Kenobi|<ref name="CW22" />}}
'''Nelvaan''' was a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] in the [[Koobi system]] in the [[Savareen sector/Legends|Savareen sector]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]] and was located at [[Galactic coordinates/Legends|galactic coordinates]] Q-16. A frigid world, Nelvaan was [[Homeworld/Legends|home]] to the [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] [[Nelvaanian/Legends|Nelvaanian]] people. The Nelvaanians were considered primitive to many, as they lived in tribal villages, one of which was named [[Rokrul]]. Each village was led by a [[Chief/Legends|chieftain]] and their bond-mate along with a [[Shaman/Legends|shaman]] who served as consultant on most matters. Religion was central in Nelvaanian culture, and the planet itself was referred to as the [[Great Mother]]. Therefore, when the [[Techno Union/Legends|Techno Union]] built a [[Techno Union laboratory|laboratory]] during the [[The galaxy/Legends|galactic]] [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] that was powered by a [[siphon generator]], a machine that absorbed geothermal energy, and the planet was plunged into an ice age, the locals became very concerned. The villagers sent all their [[Gender/Legends|male]] warriors to discover the cause of the Mother's plight, but none returned.

In the [[Standard year/Legends|year]] [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]], [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] and [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] arrived on the planet in search of [[General/Legends|General]] [[Grievous/Legends|Grievous]] of the [[Separatist Droid Army/Legends|Separatist Droid Army]]. After defeating a vicious [[Horax/Legends|horax]], the two were escorted to the Rokrul shaman [[Orvos]]. There, Orvos declared Skywalker to be the prophesied [[Holt Kazed]], or "Ghost Hand," and sent him off to heal the Great Mother. Skywalker followed Orvos' instructions and discovered the Techno Union laboratory and the Nelvaanian males. The Jedi freed the men and destroyed the base, later returning the men to their village.

==Description==
{{Quote|Something's startling these creatures."<br />"And it's not us."<br />"I feel it too."<br />"A disturbance.... I've got a bad feeling about this.|Anakin Skywalker and Obi-Wan Kenobi referring to the native horax|<ref name="CW22" />}}
[[File:Nelvaan_moons.jpg|thumb|left|220px|Nelvaan's three moons]]
Nelvaan was an icy [[Planet/Legends|planet]] located at [[Galactic coordinates/Legends|galactic coordinates]] Q-16<ref name="TCWCG" /> in the [[Koobi system]]<ref name="DB1" /> in the [[Savareen sector/Legends|Savareen sector]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]].<ref name="EAOC" /> Nelvaan had three [[Moon/Legends|moons]] and relatively low gravity at eighty-five percent. A day on Nelvaan took the standard twenty-four hours, and a [[Standard year/Legends|year]] was made up of 349 of those days.<ref name="TCWCG" /> The surface terrain consisted mostly of [[Mountain/Legends|mountains]], [[river]]s, glaciers, and [[Tree/Legends|tree]] forests. The planet's low gravity also allowed for odd landscapes featuring precarious mesas that would have toppled centuries earlier under the strains of standard gravity.<ref name="DB1" /> Nelvaan had a breathable atmosphere for [[Human/Legends|Humans]] and [[Skakoan/Legends|Skakoans]].<ref name="CW25" /> The planet's low gravity also allowed for some really massive lifeforms such as the predatory [[Horax/Legends|horax]].<ref name="DB1" /> Other creatures native to Nelvaan included the [[siltcrawler]], a common food for the horax,<ref name="DB3" /> the [[bruise-leech crawler]],<ref name="CSWEblc" /> and the [[white-furred bantha]],<ref name="TUR" /> along with other [[Bird/Legends|avian]], [[Primate/Legends|primate]], and [[Rodent/Legends|rodent]] [[Species/Legends|species]].<ref name="CW22" />

==History==
In the days of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Old Republic]], Nelvaan was still a primitive world. By the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] and the Republic, it was the only planet in the Koobi system that was not under control of the Sith Empire. During the Cold War, the Empire was of the opinion that Nelvaan was not worth conquering by force, and thus Imperial diplomats were sent to the world. The diplomats convinced the native [[Nelvaanian/Legends|Nelvaanians]] that the Empire had a legitimate right to their world, and the Empire considered using them as slaves.<ref name="TOR">{{TORcite|type=crewskill|Diplomacy|Without a Fight}}</ref> [[Bothan/Legends|Bothan]] [[Mining/Legends|miners]] occasionally stopped by the planet to fill up their [[Freighter/Legends|freighters]]' holds with water from the massive glaciers in order to sell in local space.<ref name="TCWCG" /> The miners promised invigorating, life-bolstering minerals were contained in the water, though this had never been scientifically scrutinized.<ref name="DB1" />

===Clone Wars===
{{Quote|Master&hellip;''"<br />"''Yes, Anakin, I know. There are only women and children.|Skywalker and Kenobi, upon arrival in Rokrul|<ref name="Clone Wars Chapter 23">{{CW|23}}</ref>}}
[[File:Mutantchamber.jpg|thumb|right|220px|The Techno Union mutates the captured Nelvaanian men.]]
Sometime prior to the year [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]], [[Orvos]], the [[Shaman/Legends|shaman]] of the Nelvaanian [[City/Legends|village]] of [[Rokrul]], prophesied a coming ice age.<ref name="DB1" /> During the [[The galaxy/Legends|galaxy]]-spanning [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] between then Galactic Republic and the rebelling [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]], the Confederacy-aligned [[Techno Union/Legends|Techno Union]] constructed a [[Techno Union laboratory|laboratory]] in the planet's eighth sector,<ref name="CW22" /> the [[Skakoan/Legends|Skakoan]] scientists and workers of which eventually made up three percent of the population. This base was powered by a [[siphon generator]] that fed off of thermal energy from the surrounding area. This plunged the planet into the ice age Orvos had predicted, but the climate change was so intense that the locals were still shocked. The Nelvaanians of Rokrul began to worry for their planet, which they referred to as the [[Great Mother]], and started sending out warriors and scouts to see what was ailing her. None of them returned, leaving, aside from Orvos, only women and children left in the village.<ref name="DB1" /> However, Orvos prophesied that two off-worlders would eventually come and save them from their plight.<ref name="CSWEOrvos">{{CSWECite|II|426|Orvos}}</ref>

In the year 19 BBY, [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] and [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] were sent to Nelvaan in search of the famous [[General/Legends|General]] [[Grievous/Legends|Grievous]], a leader in the [[Separatist Droid Army/Legends|Separatist Droid Army]] of the Confederacy. Upon arrival, the two [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] and their [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]] were attacked by a massive horax that killed all the clones before falling to the [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]] blade of Skywalker. The two quickly realized they had interrupted the coming-of-age ritual of the [[Tuzes-Adaz's son|son]] of Rokrul's [[Chief/Legends|Chieftain]] [[Tuzes-Adaz]].<ref name="CW22" /> Instead of having the Jedi killed on the spot, the chieftain brought them to the village to see Orvos, having remembered his prophesy regarding the two who would save them. After examining the Jedi, Orvos decided Skywalker was the prophesied [[Holt Kazed]], or "Ghost Hand." He then sent Skywalker off to find what was ailing the Great Mother.<ref name="DB1" />

Skywalker followed instructions given to him by Orvos, leading him to the secret Techno Union facility. After seeing a vision of his future,<ref name="CW24">{{CW|24}}</ref> he discovered the Nelvaanian males being mutated and experimented on by the Skakoan scientists. He rescued the warriors and [[Battle of Nelvaan|destroyed]] the base, killing the Skakoan workers out of rage. He then went on to return the men back to their women and children, who at first were hesitant to embrace them due to the massive mutations the men had undergone. With the siphon generator no longer sucking up thermal energy, the planet began to return to its normal temperature.<ref name="CW25" />

==Inhabitants==
{{Quote|You've done a great thing for these people. Well done, Anakin.|Kenobi, to Skywalker|<ref name="CW25" />}}
Nelvaanians, canine-muzzled humanoids making up ninety-six percent of the sentient population,<ref name="TCWCG" /> were the only [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] native [[Species/Legends|species]] of Nelvaan, and they lived simple primitive lives in a society organized into tribes. Each tribe was led by a chieftain and their bond-mate, with a shaman serving as a consultant on almost all matters. Their culture was centered around their religion, and they referred to their planet as the Great Mother. Because of this, motherhood was considered sacred, and along with building and gathering [[Foodstuff/Legends|food]], mothers were tasked with the most important job in society: the raising of the children. The fittest males of the villages became warrior scouts responsible for defending the people from predators and hunting game for food.<ref name="DB2">{{DB|species|nelvaanian|Nelvaanian}}</ref> The Nelvaanians had little contact with the rest of the galaxy, and they maintained no centralized government and no allegiance during the Clone Wars.<ref name="DB1" />

==Locations==
===Rokrul===
{{Main|Rokrul}}
[[File:Rokrul.png|thumb|right|200px|Rokrul village]]
Rokrul was a small Nelvaanian village located underneath a large mesa overhang. Its buildings, of which there were at least fifteen, were either made out of rocks or made from hollowing out stalagmites growing from the floor. There were at least eighty-five villagers from several different tribes, as the village was the result of a loose affiliation among those tribes for protection and assistance. The village women wore long [[Color/Legends|brown]], gray, and red [[Clothing/Legends|gowns]], while the men wore pants and loincloths with no top and children wore robe-like garments that were often brown.

===Techno Union laboratory===
{{Main|Techno Union laboratory}}

==Behind the scenes==
The planet gets its name from [[Nelvana]], the animation company that made the [[The Story of the Faithful Wookiee|animated segment]] in ''[[The Star Wars Holiday Special]]'', and produced the [[Ewoks (television series)|''Ewoks'']] and [[Star Wars: Droids: The Adventures of R2-D2 and C-3PO|''Droids'']] animated series.
